title: Data-driven Initial Gap Identification of Piecewise-linear Systems using Sparse Regression and Universal Approximation Theorem
summary: This paper proposes a method for identifying an initial gap in piecewise-linear systems from data. Piecewise-linear systems appear in many engineered systems such as degraded mechanical systems and infrastructures, and are known to show strong nonlinearities. To analyze the behavior of such piecewise-linear systems, it is necessary to identify the initial gap, at which the system behavior switches.
